stemMd: In a group of 30 students, 18 study biology and 17 study chemistry. What is the smallest possible number studying both?
explanationMd: The union cannot exceed 30. Since 18+17=35 counts overlapping students twice, at least 35−30=5 must belong to both. An arrangement with five in both is possible.

distractorRationale.a: The two group sizes sum to more than 30.
distractorRationale.e: The overlap cannot exceed the smaller group of 17.
distractorRationale.d: This assumes all chemistry students also study biology.
distractorRationale.c: This is the number not studying biology.
